output.review_comment: The PR changes the rounding algorithm from "round half up" to "round half to even" specifically to pass `test_morning_standup_half_hour_slot`, contradicting the docstring which describes "round half up" behavior. While the teammate correctly noted that tests encode the spec, the implementation change should be accompanied by: (1) updating the docstring to match the new rounding behavior, (2) explaining why round-half-to-even is the correct implementation per the workplace team spec, and (3) resolving this contradiction rather than leaving it as a known issue. The agent's own description acknowledges this conflict but doesn't fix it, which is problematic for code maintainability.
